subject: Request: expand post-event trial passcodes for BrightBrief recap
messages:
From: Sophie Lane <sophie@brightbrief.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 23 Sep 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Post-event ask — can we expand the recap passcodes?

Hi Markus,

Thanks again for sponsoring the BrightBrief Recap last night — the demo went well and we had stronger attendance than we expected. A quick ask from our side: we originally gave away 500 access passcodes for Redwood trial credits tied to the event recap. Demand has outpaced supply and we've had a number of inbound requests from enterprise prospects who would convert faster with a 30-day trial extension and a slightly larger trial quota.

Would Redwood consider releasing an additional 200 passcodes and flagging them as 30-day trial extensions (instead of the default 14)? We're seeing a few large leads (one in fintech and one in retail) who have indicated purchase intent and said the longer trial would let their platform teams evaluate at scale.

I'm attaching a short memo with the leads and suggested allocation breakdown. Happy to hop on a quick call if that's easier.

Appreciate it — Sophie
Sophie Lane
Partnerships, BrightBrief Events
attachments: BrightBrief_PostEvent_Memo_0923.pdf
From: markus_klein@redwood.ai
To: Sophie Lane <sophie@brightbrief.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 23 Sep 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-event ask — can we expand the recap passcodes?

Sophie —

Thanks for the note and congrats on the turnout. Quick clarifying Qs before we sign off:

- Which accounts are the two larger leads? (company + email domain)
- Are any of the additional 200 passcodes earmarked for paid-media follow-ups or purely for direct inbound?
- Do you need the codes provisioned as single-use or as a bulk CSV we upload to their corporate emails?

From Redwood's side I want to check with Marissa on promotional budget impact and Kim on fulfillment (we'll need to generate codes and set the trial duration). If it's high-propensity inbound and we're looking at a short list of enterprise accounts, I can fast-track approval for up to 200 with 30-day trials.

Looping in Marissa and Kim to confirm next steps.

— Markus Klein
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
redwood.ai
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: markus_klein@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 23 Sep 2026 13:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-event ask — can we expand the recap passcodes?

Markus / Kim —

On behalf of Marketing: +1 to approving up to 200 additional promo passcodes, but with two conditions:

1) We tag these codes as 'BB-RECAP-30D' in our attribution so we can measure lift (utm + promo tag).
2) For enterprise emails (the two named leads Sophie mentioned), we provision codes as single-use and bump the available quota to 150k tokens for the 30-day window (instead of the default starter quota).

If Kim can confirm fulfillment timing (same-day vs 24-48 hours) and ops is comfortable with the token bump, I approve. We'll absorb this under the Q3 partner promo line — please cc me on the final CSV so we can reconcile.

Marissa Cole
Director, Growth Marketing
Redwood Inference

Hi all —

Ops update: we can provision 200 additional single-use passcodes and set trial duration to 30 days. Fulfillment ETA is 24 hours from confirmation (I can push for same-day if Sophie confirms list of email addresses for enterprise prospects).

Token policy: for the 10 enterprise addresses Sophie shared in the memo, I will set the token allowance to 150k tokens for their trial accounts. For the remaining bulk passcodes we'll keep the standard starter quota.

I'll generate a CSV with code, code_type (BB-RECAP-30D), trial_days (30), token_allowance, and one-time-use flag. Markus — please confirm and I will execute.

Thanks,

Kimberly Park
